about: The UKRI AI Centre for Doctoral Training in Designing Responsible NLP at the University of Edinburgh recruits 2027 studentships in two stages. Stage 1 applications close at midnight GMT on 30 November 2026; invited applicants then submit a full application in January 2027.
requirements: Two-stage process: Stage 1 application by 30 November 2026 is required to be invited to a full Stage 2 application (deadline in January 2027)
Overseas applicants receive the standard UKRI stipend rate
